## Wording
- Chamber / json-chamber = security **unlock** ($99 / domain after 24h). Not compression. Not a seat.
- TRU8 = compression. Demos free with credit. Production residual = **license**.
- tru8-chamber = **project license** ($1,900 / project / year). Not a per-user seat.
- Suite = **metered jobs** (100 GB then ~5¢/GB). Not a seat.
- Access = entitlement claim. Seat = named human or agent identity only.

## Scope
json-chamber = security ($99 unlock).
tru8-chamber = TRU8+security project license ($1,900/yr, closed).
TruGame = game engine under active build (private source).
TRU8 residual engine never open-sourced.
